title: Join Service State
description:
Splits off a piece of work and gets the answer back **beside** what you already
had, rather than instead of it. (Runtimes: node, python; IDs: join)

as.description: Put the result under this key. Empty merges at the top level

mode.description: Top-level merge only: overwrite or add

onFailure.description: A detour that failed: stop, or merge its { error, service } in place of the result — under as, or under failure without one
